label: GitHub Repository File
description: A Markdown file under a path that GITHUB_FILES names, read from the repository's default branch. Read only: GitHub is the source, and a change made in Marfa is put back on the next run. It joins the collection of its directory.

repository.description: The repository's full name, as owner/name.

path.description: The file's path in the repository, from its root.

blob_sha.description: The Git object ID of the file's contents, which changes whenever its contents do.

url.description: The file's address on GitHub, on the default branch.

private.description: Whether the repository this row is in is private on GitHub, as of the last read: a row marked private holds what is not public, and its contents are not to be copied into a public place.
